Zirconite

Back to materials database

Quick answer

Check Meriam at City Hall for Zirconite. Player reports point to her as the seller. Check the price in your game.

How to get it

  1. In early August 2026, a Steam moderator said buying Zirconite was the only option before mines were implemented.
  2. Player reports point to Meriam at City Hall. Check her offer for the price and availability in your game.

Where to look

  • City Hall: look for Meriam, the seller named in player reports.
  • A current mining or wild-ore route has not been verified.

Main uses and linked content

Check the required quantity when a blueprint or building asks for Zirconite, then check Meriam's offer at City Hall.

What to do next

  1. Check the blueprint or building requirement first, then use the City Hall map link to continue to Meriam.
  2. Confirm the price and required quantity in your game before buying.

Prices and rewards: recorded separately

Purchase price
Not recorded; acquisition notes are not a shop quote.
Sell price
Not recorded; inventory or hand-in quantities are not sell prices.
Quest reward
No reward paid in this material is recorded.
Acquisition evidence and source boundary

  • In an early August 2026 reply, a Steam moderator identified buying Zirconite as the only option at the time, while mines were still planned. Official

    Source: Steam thread: Questions about the game (official moderator answer) · Build: Early Access (build not stated)

  • Multiple community answers identify Meriam at City Hall as the seller. The retained evidence does not support publishing a stable current price. Community-confirmed
